thread_analysis.thread_summary: JUST.WILL Co., Ltd. (contact Hiroshi Tsukui) inquires with Allion (Masaya Iida, with guidance from Itsuo Sakai) about Bluetooth SIG certification, surfacing a scope misunderstanding (assuming SIG member/Adopter registration was included in the support engagement) and a recent rule change (effective November 10, 2025) requiring profile testing even for certified-component-based registrations.
all_questions_found: Is SIG member/Adopter registration included in Allion's support, and what's the new profile testing rule for certified components? (see thread_0257_case_01)
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: SIG member/Adopter registration is a categorical customer-side prerequisite, separate from registration support services; the November 2025 rule change requiring IOPT even when referencing a certified Component represents a meaningful cost and scope change from the prior exemption-based approach customers may still expect.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Confirm SIG member/Adopter registration status explicitly at the start of new engagements, and proactively flag recent certification rule changes (like the November 2025 IOPT requirement) that could affect a customer's cost expectations based on outdated assumptions.
